svg.title: Figure 2-1: interaction scenarios as scene cards
svg.desc: Twelve cards in a grid, one per interaction scenario: a top-down pictogram on a one-metre grid with the robot, its direction of travel, its one-metre protective field and rear bumper, the person or persons and their movement, racks, a dock, a screen or a charger where the scenario needs them, a caption and the measure needed.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 2-1 Interaction scenarios IS-01…IS-12 as scene cards (top-down, 1 m grid)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Robot with its direction of travel, its 1.0 m starting field (teal) and the rear bumper (red); people as head-and-shoulders, dashed when below the scan plane.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Caption: what happens; below it, the measure the §2 table names.
